name: h200-runpod-s2

provenance._suite: profiler/calibrate.py run 2026-09-15; raw outputs in calibrate-raw-h200-runpod-s2/
provenance.field_mul_Gps: bench_field_mul best-of-5, grid 1056x256 (full occupancy on 132 SMs), 2026-09-15
provenance.blake3_compress_Gps: bench_blake3_columns best over m sweep, 2026-09-15 — memory-bandwidth-limited at large m; NOT a basis for B

provenance.hbm_chase_ns: bench_hbm_random dependent pointer chase, 2026-09-15 — per-hop WALL across the default 65536 walkers: a throughput figure, NOT the single-access HBM latency (rerun with --walkers 1 for that)
provenance.mem_bandwidth_GBps: torch d2d copy, read+write counted (2x bytes), 2026-09-15
provenance.A_ns_per_slot: DERIVED from gb10-spark x bandwidth ratio (223/4260 GB/s) — replace via validation-mode recalibration
provenance.C_ns_per_product: DERIVED from gb10-spark x bandwidth ratio (223/4260 GB/s) — replace via validation-mode recalibration
provenance.B_ns_per_cid: DIRECT: one challenge compress per cid at the measured register-resident rate (10.4 Gc/s); no cross-machine baseline yet — run bench_blake3_reg on gb10-spark to upgrade to a ratioed value. Leans floor-ward structurally: raw ALU compress only, no launch/orchestration margin — replace via validation-mode recalibration
